# Welcome {-}

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

Welcome to the **ForestPlots.net Training Manual**. This guide is designed to help new and existing users of [ForestPlots.net](https://forestplots.net) — the global network for monitoring tropical forest plots — to get the most out of the platform.

## How to use this manual {-}

This manual is organised into chapters that follow a natural workflow, from creating an account through to downloading and analysing data. You can read it sequentially or jump to the chapter most relevant to your needs.

- **New users** should start with Chapters \@ref(introduction) and \@ref(getting-started).
- **Data contributors** will find Chapters \@ref(data-entry) and \@ref(data-quality) most useful.
- **Data users** seeking to query or download data should head to Chapter \@ref(querying-data).
- **R users** will find the `RAINFOR` / ForestPlots R package covered in Chapter \@ref(r-package).

## About ForestPlots.net {-}

ForestPlots.net is a pan-tropical network and database hosting long-term forest inventory data from permanent sample plots across the tropics. It supports research into forest dynamics, carbon stocks, and ecosystem responses to climate change.
